kurz: Wine brings acidity, aromas and a little sweetness to sauces and braises. The alcohol dissolves aromas and mostly evaporates.
bild_im_kopf: Like a seasoning in liquid form.
was_passiert: The [[saeure|acid]] in wine makes sauces lively. When reduced, acidity, aromas and [[gerbstoffe|tannins]] concentrate. Some of the alcohol remains even after long cooking.
faustregeln: Only use wine you would also drink.
Reduce red wine well, otherwise it tastes raw and harsh.
